t2.thesis: FLEX should beat EPS again, but its history of selling off on beats in BMO prints and the heavy financing and spin-off overhang offset the bounce potential of a stock that has already fallen 32% in a month, leaving the odds only slightly above a coin flip.
reasons: Sell-the-news pattern: all three recent BMO prints fell (-9.0%, -3.5%, -9.2%) despite EPS beats of 4-11%; the only gain was the AMC print (+28.7%). Last-4 win rate is 0.25.
The stock is down 32% over one month and 52% from its 52-week high, so a lot of bad news may already be priced in. That raises the odds of a relief rally if guidance holds or rises.

Balance-sheet and spin-off overhang: the $4.4B EPC Power deal was funded with a $1.1B bridge loan and a $3.3B term facility, plus Axiom preferred stock. The stock fell 6.9% on spin-off financial-risk concerns.
Fundamentals remain solid: revenue up about 21% YoY, guidance raised last quarter, EPS estimates revised up 5.6% over 90 days, forward P/E around 10.6, and a strong-buy consensus.
Options lean mildly bullish: call IV is above put IV, put/call ratios are around 0.46-0.47, and short interest is low at 2.4%.
t2.deciding_variable: Q2 FY27 revenue and EPS against guidance midpoints (about $8.1B and $1.035), and whether FY27 guidance is raised again including the EPC Power contribution, together with any change to leverage or spin-off timing.

theses.mechanism: A beat and raise with strong CPI/AI data-center growth triggers short-covering and a relief rally from a deeply oversold level.
theses.wrong_if: Guidance only matches consensus, or free cash flow and working capital deteriorate again.

theses.mechanism: This repeats the BMO sell-the-news pattern: the EPS beat is offset by weak free cash flow, rising inventory, memory-cost margin pressure or higher interest expense from the new debt.
theses.wrong_if: FY guidance is raised materially and management gives clear deleveraging and spin-off value milestones.

theses.mechanism: Non-CPI segments (lifestyle, automotive, industrial) look soft, which reinforces worries that RemainCo is a low-growth EMS business once Axiom is separated.
theses.wrong_if: RMS and ITS show stable or improving margins, or management provides attractive pro-forma RemainCo targets ahead of the Nov 10 Investor Day.
